about.description: nALPHA is the receipt token for Nest's diversified "balanced yield" vault. Nest discloses a blended composition across crypto basis strategy (25%), American oil & gas / mineral and royalty interests (25%), private credit (23%), U.S. Treasuries (15%), plus smaller allocations to ETFs (12%), money market funds (1%), and senior secured debt (1%). The disclosed component list includes a 25% allocation to Nest Basis Vault, 25% Mineral Vault (mineral & royalty interests), 15% Nest Treasury Vault, 15% LiquidStone by BlackOpal (invoice financing), 8% Whinfell (tokenized ETFs), 8% Kasu (invoice financing), and smaller allocations to Blackstone SRLN (2%), OpenTrade XHYCB (BlackRock corporate bond ETF, 2%), OpenTrade XMMF (Fidelity Institutional Liquidity MMF, 1%), and Invesco iSNR (senior loan strategy, 1%)
